@deskRecvReceiving.description: Label before the method icons in the Receive page header, and before the on/off switch of each receiving method.

@deskRecvNameFile.description: Name of the file method (transaction files) when read out in a screen reader line such as "File off".

@deskRecvTurnOnFailed.description: Toast title when turning a receiving method on failed; the reason follows as text. {method} is Epicbox, HTTP, Tor or File.

@deskRecvTurnOffFailed.description: Toast title when turning a receiving method off failed; the reason follows as text. {method} is Epicbox, HTTP, Tor or File.

@deskRecvOtherWays.description: Heading above the HTTP or Tor panel on Receive.

@deskRecvSettings.description: Small button next to the Other ways to receive heading: opens Settings › Receiving.

@deskRecvTorNotConnected.description: Title of the notice on Receive when Tor failed.

@deskRecvTorStarting.description: Title of the notice on Receive while Tor connects.

deskRecvTorDownText: Every connection waits for Tor. Retry, or turn Tor off.

@deskRecvTorDownText.description: Text of the notice on Receive when Tor failed.

deskRecvTorStartingText: Addresses become reachable when Tor connects.

@deskRecvTorStartingText.description: Text of the notice on Receive while Tor connects. "it" is Tor.

@deskRecvTurnTorOff.description: Button in the Tor failed notice on Receive: switches Tor off.

@deskRecvTryAgain.description: Retry button on the HTTP panel on Receive when the HTTP listener failed.

@deskRecvStateOn.description: Spoken state of a receiving method for screen readers, lowercase: the method is on.

@deskRecvStateOff.description: Spoken state of a receiving method for screen readers, lowercase: the method is off.

@deskRecvStateChecking.description: Spoken state of a receiving method for screen readers, lowercase: still being checked.

@deskRecvSemList.description: Screen reader text for one receiving method in the page header summary, e.g. "Epicbox on". The summary joins these with commas.

@deskRecvSemMethod.description: Screen reader label of a receiving method's icon button in the page header, e.g. "Epicbox: on".

@deskRecvTipChecking.description: Tooltip of a receiving method's icon in the page header while it is being checked.

@deskRecvTip.description: Tooltip of a receiving method's icon in the page header. {state} is the state word such as On or Off.

@deskRecvTipDetail.description: Tooltip of a receiving method's icon in the page header with a second line of detail.

@deskRecvTagPaused.description: Small tag on the covered Epicbox QR code while Epicbox receiving is off.

@deskRecvTagStarting.description: Small tag on a QR code while its receiving method starts.

@deskRecvTagNotReachable.description: Small tag on a QR code when its receiving method does not work.

deskRecvAddressUnreadable: The address could not be read. Open Receive again in a moment.

@deskRecvAddressUnreadable.description: Shown instead of an address when the wallet could not read it.

@deskRecvEpicboxAddress.description: Title of the Epicbox panel and of its QR code on Receive.

@deskRecvCopyEpicbox.description: Screen reader and tooltip label of the copy button next to the Epicbox address.

deskRecvEpicboxIntro: Share it to get paid. Senders can pay while this wallet is closed.

@deskRecvEpicboxIntro.description: Intro text of the Epicbox panel on Receive.

deskRecvCheckSix: When reading it out, check the first six and last six characters.

@deskRecvCheckSix.description: Caption under the Epicbox address on Receive.

@deskRecvHttpAddress.description: Title of the HTTP panel on Receive and of its QR code.

@deskRecvCopyHttp.description: Label of the copy button next to the HTTP address.

deskRecvHttpPublic: Your router’s public address. Senders on the internet use it once the router forwards port {port}.

@deskRecvHttpPublic.description: Caption under the HTTP address when receiving from the internet is on. {port} is the port number.

deskRecvHttpLocal: Programs on this computer can pay this address. For other devices, see Settings › Transactions.

@deskRecvHttpLocal.description: Caption under the HTTP address when receiving is only for this computer.

deskRecvHttpIntro: For wallets on this computer, while this wallet is open.

@deskRecvHttpIntro.description: Intro text of the HTTP panel on Receive.

deskRecvHttpTorHint: Turn on Tor in Settings › Privacy for a Tor address instead.

@deskRecvHttpTorHint.description: Caption at the bottom of the HTTP panel on Receive.

@deskRecvDirectTor.description: Title of the Tor panel on Receive.

deskRecvTorIntro: Straight from another wallet over Tor while this one is open. Tor is set in Settings › Privacy.

@deskRecvTorIntro.description: Intro text of the Tor panel on Receive.

@deskRecvTorAddress.description: Title of the QR code of the Tor address on Receive.

@deskRecvCopyTor.description: Label of the copy button next to the Tor address.

deskRecvTorOnion: Some wallets show the address without .onion; both are the same address.

@deskRecvTorOnion.description: Caption under the Tor address on Receive.

@deskRecvFiles.description: Heading of the transaction files panel on Receive.

@deskRecvSignTitle.description: Row title in the transaction files panel: opens the page that signs a file the sender gave.

deskRecvSignText: Sign the sender’s transaction file and save the response file.

@deskRecvSignText.description: Row text under Sign a transaction file.

@deskRecvOpen.description: Button on the rows of the transaction files panel.

@deskRecvFinalizeTitle.description: Row title in the transaction files panel: opens the page that finalizes a response file.

deskRecvFinalizeText: Finalize the recipient’s response file to post the payment.

@deskRecvFinalizeText.description: Row text under Finalize a response file.

@deskRecvSwitchLabel.description: Screen reader label of a receiving method's on/off switch. {title} is the panel's title, e.g. Epicbox address.

@deskRecvTorOffTitle.description: Notice on Receive while Link · Tor is on (Settings › Transactions) and Tor (Settings › Privacy) is off: no Tor address until Tor runs.

deskRecvTorOffText: The Tor address works while Tor is on. Tor is Settings › Privacy’s switch; it routes the wallet’s connections through Tor.

@deskRecvTorOffText.description: Second line of the Link · Tor needs Tor notice on Receive. Buttons: Turn on Tor, Settings (opens Privacy).

deskRecvHttpIntroInternet: For wallets on the internet, while this wallet is open.

@deskRecvHttpIntroInternet.description: Receive › Link · HTTP: line under the address when the HTTP listener is reachable from the internet (Settings › Transactions › From the internet).
